conditions.evidence: Developmental prosopagnosics have normal spatial integration
conditions.label: developmental prosopagnosia

output.population: 40 participants, ages 20–58, developmental prosopagnosics and controls
output.summary: Raw fMRI data from developmental prosopagnosics and controls across two sessions: an anatomical scan plus a multi-category localizer to define face- and scene-selective regions, and population receptive field mapping runs.
